responsibility: This header declares the public entry points for the C front end’s textual GIMPLE parsing support. It exposes routines used by the main parser to parse a function body written in GIMPLE form and to parse lists of GIMPLE or RTL passes associated with such declarations.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the minimal public interface for textual GIMPLE parsing, declaring the entry points that gcc/c/c-parser.cc can call for GIMPLE bodies or pass lists, while gcc/c/gimple-parser.cc contains the actual parsing machinery, grammar handling, and CFG-building implementation.
